reason: The hypothesis directly restates the combined nitriding+texturing treatment and its outcomes already reported in P4 and P7, using the same material (Ti-6Al-4V), similar nitriding conditions (750°C from P10/P24), and the same mechanisms (hardness from nitriding, friction reduction from texturing). The only new element is a specific falsification test, but the core idea is a copy of prior work.
copied_elements: Two-step treatment: plasma nitriding + laser surface texturing on Ti-6Al-4V
Plasma nitriding at 750°C in NH3-N2 mixture
Nitriding forms hard TiN/Ti2N layer and diffusion zone
Nitriding increases surface hardness and compressive residual stress
Laser surface texturing creates micro-dimples to reduce friction and trap debris
Combined treatment reduces friction coefficient and wear rate
Mechanism: hard nitride layer inhibits dislocation motion; dimples reduce contact area
